verdict.rationale: Identity platforms can plausibly offer versioned automation hooks, so this story applies to WorkOS. However, the evidence pack documents no automations feature and no versioning, review, or rollback of one. Adjacent items such as audit logs, feature-flag rollout control, and the MCP server that edits dashboard data do not provide versioned or rollback-capable automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
